terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A rigid welded A-frame barrier: nothing opens, turns or swings, nothing attaches, so one root pivot and zero sockets. It repeats in rows of five to ten, so the draw-call ceiling is the design constraint. Checkpoints, festival closures, accident scenes; rows of five to ten. Rusting galvanised tube, a chevron panel with the Royal Thai Police badge and ตำรวจ, grime along the bottom edge.

reasoning: ONE tube merge -- two A-frames of two legs and a brace each, the bar behind the panel, two diagonal stays, ten rust sleeves (feet, brace joints, apexes) and four bolt heads -- on galvanised steel; ONE sign panel box on a BAKED material: TWO draw calls of 2.

Two materials: galvanised steel (vertex colours: zinc, rust) with a rust canvas, and the printed sign face as a baked WebP data URI -- the registry notes say the badge and lettering are a printed graphic and belong on a canvas.
No repetition system: two A-frames are two tube sets in one merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the red-and-white chevron panel with the police badge and ตำรวจ on tube A-frames; the graphic is projected from the plate's own printed region because a drawn wordmark differs per machine and a wrong badge is a wrong prop.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.50 x 1.10 x 0.66 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

pivotInventory.justification: The rigid body of the prop at its declared origin. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it, and only real mechanisms get one.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

silhouette.description: Two tube A-frames 1.10 m tall at x +-0.732 with feet splayed to z +-0.31, a brace at 0.24 and a bar between the apexes BEHIND the panel; a 1.44 x 0.60 x 0.02 sign panel from 0.48 to 1.08 whose top edge is the leg tops; two diagonal stays from the brace joints to the panel foot at x +-0.50.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-0.75 at the leg tubes just outside the 1.44 m panel (declared 1.50); y 0 to 1.098 at the apex sleeves (declared 1.10); z +-0.33 at the splayed feet (declared 0.66, CORRECTED from 0.55: the proxy reads d/h 0.762 with feet at 0.007-0.755 H, the plate near frame spreads its feet ~0.6 of the leg height, 0.66 sits between). Proxy occupancy: panel 0.46-0.98 H across the full width, legs at the EXTREME columns only (no x splay; the panel runs to the legs and its top is the leg tops -- the plate shows bare open tube ends at the panel's top corners and no bar above it), a brace at ~0.22 H and a diagonal stay from the brace joint to the panel foot near x +-0.33 W; w:h 1.648 is not followed (the plate reads ~1.3 once the yaw is allowed for) and the declared 1.50 x 1.10 stands.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: w:h:d 1:0.607:0.463, 1,501 triangles; occupancy reads the panel 0.46-0.98 H full width with the legs at the extreme columns, the brace and stays below; built 0.48-1.08 (0.44-0.98 H).

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/tube.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.840. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.evidence: crops/rust.png -- rust at every foot and weld; six tinted blocks plus the rust canvas.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-tube (0.84) at #717170 (a leg in shade); carried at #9a9c9c as a vertex colour on a WHITE material with rust sleeves as vertex tone -- #6f5c4a over the feet, #857a6c bloom at the brace joints and open apexes -- the plate's dull brown speckle rather than an orange block.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px rust canvas after construction.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components, no repetition system: 2 of 2.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 652 of 2,000: nineteen 6-8 segment tubes, five boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tubes for every leg, brace, bar and stay; a box for the panel; boxes for the bolt heads; coaxial tube sleeves for the rust.
No InstancedMesh: two A-frames are one merge. In a scene the HOST instances the barrier along a row.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Both materials are declared textureless. One 256 px rust canvas plus one baked 1024 x 384 WebP (28 KB) after construction.

risks.description: The sign is a TextureLoader data URI; a host that blocks data URIs shows a white panel.
risks.mitigation: The harness reported texturesPending 0 and no textureErrors; the material colour is white so a failed load reads as an unprinted panel, not black.

risks.description: The back of the panel shows the same graphic mirrored.
risks.mitigation: Recorded as an assumption; real panels are usually printed both sides.
